claims.text:
stage computation: Undirected chain A–B–C–D, initial markers[1,0,0,0]. One synchronous layer sets h_next(v)=max(h(v), all neighbour h). Rounds produce[1,1,0,0], [1,1,1,0], [1,1,1,1]. Use a fresh old-state snapshot each round, never in-place propagation.

**Countercase / boundary:** Remove edge B–C before restarting: C and D stay0 for any round. This is a fixed max-aggregation message-passing circuit with self information, not a trained GNN or a guarantee of structural distinguishability.

**Prediction / transfer recall:** Predict first round D can depend on A; recall moving initial marker to C reaches both B and D after one round, A after two.

**Intervention / reachable witness:** Step layer visibly highlights reached nodes and causal edges; Cut edge restarts current propagation while preserving original three-round witness. Make synchronous dependence explicit.
